set.body: Port the first fmriAR estimation/diagnostic layer idiomatically. Scope: ACVF/Yule-Walker estimation, fixed AR order, auto order by BIC, PACF/AR conversion, stationarity enforcement, and residual autocorrelation diagnostics. Acceptance: deterministic tests cover fixed order, near-unit-root handling, whiteness reduction, and finite diagnostic output on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Slice 14: AR estimation and diagnostics
